name: runtime-sop
description: Local-first Chrome workflow recorder and shared SOP reader

scripts.build: node tools/build-example.cjs && node tools/build-dashboard.cjs && node tools/build-mobile-reader.cjs && node tools/scan-public.cjs && node tools/package.cjs
scripts.test:team-browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/team-workspace-browser.cjs tests/team-library-browser.cjs tests/team-service-picker-browser.cjs tests/team-read-view-browser.cjs tests/team-library-images-browser.cjs tests/team-sidebar-images-browser.cjs
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:team-service && npm run build:release-media && node tools/release-checksums.cjs
